# libmobi source

Vendored from [bfabiszewski/libmobi](https://github.com/bfabiszewski/libmobi),
commit `906274205c11944b628da1c553b255acb1af7c55` (version 0.12).
Copyright Bartek Fabiszewski and contributors. Licensed under LGPL-3.0-or-later;
see `COPYING`. The library is built as a separate shared object so it can be

The MOBI instrumentation fixtures come from that repository's
`tests/samples/` directory at the same commit.
